title: English Conversation 5:  The Old Days
content: 1. to be mean to someone: to not be nice to a person - She is mean to me. - He is often mean to his employees. He is not a nice boss. 2. used to do something: did something in the past but now do not do it - I used to play basketball every weekend, but these days I can't play because I hurt my knee. - He used to eat a lot of hamburgers, but now he is trying to be healthy, so he only eats a hamburger once a month.
